arxiv-1704-08707.title: CubeSat Quantum Communications Mission
arxiv-1704-08707.creator: DKLODaniel K L Oi, ALAlex Ling, GVGiuseppe Vallone, PVPaolo Villoresi, SGSteve Greenland, EKEmma Kerr, MMMalcolm Macdonald, HWHarald Weinfurter, JMKHans Kuiper, ECEdoardo Charbon, RURupert Ursin
arxiv-1704-08707.description: Abstract Quantum communication is a prime space technology application and offers near-term possibilities for long-distance quantum key distribution (QKD) and experimental tests of quantum entanglement. However, there exists considerable developmental risks and subsequent costs and time required to raise the technological readiness level of terrestrial quantum technologies and to adapt them for space operations.

arxiv-2003-00768.title: Convolutional Sparse Support Estimator Network (CSEN) From energy efficient support estimation to learning-aided Compressive Sensing
arxiv-2003-00768.creator: Mehmet Yamaç, Mete Ahishali, Serkan Kiranyaz, Moncef Gabbouj
arxiv-2003-00768.description: Abstract Support estimation (SE) of a sparse signal refers to finding the location indices of the non-zero elements in a sparse representation. Most of the traditional approaches dealing with SE problem are iterative algorithms based on greedy methods or optimization techniques.

arxiv-2208-13233.title: Monte-Carlo simulations for wall-bounded fluid flows via random vortex method
arxiv-2208-13233.creator: By Z. Qian, Y. Qiu, L. Zhao, and J. Wu
arxiv-2208-13233.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by By Z. Qian, Y. Qiu, L. Zhao, and J. Wu. In this paper a Monte-Carlo method for simulating the motion of fluid flow moving along a solid wall is proposed. The random vortex method in the present paper is established by using the reflection technology and perturbation technique. The Monte-Carlo method based on this random vortex dynamic may be implemented, and several Monte-Carlo simulations are then carried out for the flows near the solid wall.

arxiv-2210-03060.title: LODUS: A Multi-Level Framework for Simulating Environment and Population - A Contagion Experiment on a Pandemic World
arxiv-2210-03060.creator: Gabriel Fonseca Silva, Vinícius Cassol, Amyr Borges Fortes Neto, Andre Antonitsch, Diogo Schaffer, Soraia Raupp Musse, Rodrigo de Marsillac Linn
arxiv-2210-03060.description: Abstract Nowadays we are experiencing a way of life that never existed before. The pandemic has sharply changed our habits, customs, and behavior. In addition, a lot of work was suddenly requested for city managers challenging them to develop strategies to try stopping the pandemic progression.

arxiv-2301-05133.title: Is AI Art Another Industrial Revolution in the Making?
arxiv-2301-05133.creator: Alexis Newton, Kaustubh Dhole
arxiv-2301-05133.description: Abstract A major shift from skilled to unskilled workers was one of the many changes caused by the Industrial Revolution, when the switch to machines contributed to decline in the social and economic status of artisans, whose skills were dismembered into discrete actions by factory-line workers.

arxiv-2307-07414.title: An Embedded Auto-Calibrated Offset Current Compensation Technique for PPG/fNIRS System
arxiv-2307-07414.creator: Sadan Saquib Khan, Sumit Kumar, Benish Jan, Laxmeesha Somappa, and Shahid Malik
arxiv-2307-07414.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sadan Saquib Khan, Sumit Kumar, Benish Jan, Laxmeesha Somappa, and Shahid Malik. Usually, the current generated by the photodiode proportional to the oxygenated blood in the photoplethysmography (PPG) and functional infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) based recording systems is small as compared to the offset-current. The offset current is the combination of the dark current of the photodiode, the current due to ambient light, and the current due to the reflected light from fat and skull [ 1 , 2 ] .

arxiv-2308-04522.title: Deep Learning for Steganalysis of Diverse Data Types: A review of methods, taxonomy, challenges and future directions
arxiv-2308-04522.creator: Hamza Kheddarcor1, Mustapha Hemis, Yassine Himeur, David Megías, Abbes Amira
arxiv-2308-04522.description: Abstract Steganography and steganalysis are two interrelated aspects of the field of information security. Steganography seeks to conceal communications, whereas steganalysis aims to discover or, if possible, recover the data they contain. These two areas have garnered significant interest, especially among law enforcement agencies.

arxiv-2309-15239.title: Degenerate interpretations of O 3 \text{O}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}} spectral features in exoplanet atmosphere observations due to stellar UV uncertainties: a 3D case study with TRAPPIST-1e
arxiv-2309-15239.creator: G. J. Cooke, D. R. Marsh, C. Walsh, A. Youngblood
arxiv-2309-15239.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by G. J. Cooke, D. R. Marsh, C. Walsh, A. Youngblood. TRAPPIST-1e is a potentially habitable terrestrial exoplanet orbiting an ultra-cool M Dwarf star and is a key target for observations with the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). One-dimensional photochemical modelling of terrestrial planetary atmospheres has shown the importance of the incoming stellar UV flux in modulating the concentration of chemical species, such as O 3 \text{O}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}} and H 2 ​ O \text{H}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{O} .

arxiv-2407-11281.title: High-Resolution Dayside Spectroscopy of WASP-189b: Detection of Iron during the GHOST/Gemini South System Verification Run Facilities: Gemini:South (GHOST), Exoplanet Archive
arxiv-2407-11281.creator: Emily K. Deibert, Adam B. Langeveld, Mitchell E. Young, Laura Flagg, Jake D. Turner, Peter C. B. Smith, Ernst J. W. de Mooij, Ray Jayawardhana, Kristin Chiboucas, Roberto Gamen, Christian R. Hayes, Jeong-Eun Heo, Miji Jeong, Venu Kalari, Eder Martioli, Vinicius M. Placco, Siyi Xu, Ruben Diaz, Manuel
arxiv-2407-11281.description: Abstract With high equilibrium temperatures and tidally locked rotation, ultra-hot Jupiters (UHJs) are unique laboratories within which to probe extreme atmospheric physics and chemistry. In this paper, we present high-resolution dayside spectroscopy of the UHJ WASP-189b obtained with the new Gemini High-resolution Optical SpecTrograph (GHOST) at the Gemini South Observatory.

arxiv-2508-15896.title: The Quantum Ensemble Variational Optimization Algorithm: Applications to Molecular Inverse Design
arxiv-2508-15896.creator: Francesco Calcagno, Delmar G. A. Cabral, Ivan Rivalta, Victor S. Batista
arxiv-2508-15896.description: Abstract Designing molecules with optimized properties remains a fundamental challenge due to the intricate relationship between molecular structure and properties. Traditional computational approaches that address the combinatorial number of possible molecular designs become unfeasible as the molecular size increases, suffering from the so-called ‘curse of dimensionality’ problem. Recent advances in quantum computing hardware present new opportunities to address this problem.

arxiv-2509-08921.title: Operator realizations about a matrix-centre
arxiv-2509-08921.creator: Ali Karoobi, Robert T.W. Martin, Maximilian Tornes
arxiv-2509-08921.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ali Karoobi, Robert T.W. Martin, Maximilian Tornes. We develop a general theory of operator realizations, or “linear representations” of analytic functions in several non-commuting variables about a matrix–centre. In particular we show that a non-commutative function has a matrix-centre realization about any matrix tuple, Y Y , in its domain, if and only if it is a uniformly analytic non-commutative function defined in a uniformly open neighbourhood of Y Y .

europmc-pmc5582349.title: Small nucleoli are a cellular hallmark of longevity.
europmc-pmc5582349.creator: Tiku V, Jain C, Raz Y, Nakamura S, Heestand B, Liu W, Späth M, Suchiman HED, Müller RU, Slagboom PE, Partridge L, Antebi A.

Here we show that NCL-1/TRIM2/Brat tumour suppressor extends lifespan and limits...

pmc-10555955.title: FRI499 The Importance Of Identifying Atypical Presentation Of Thyroid Storm
pmc-10555955.creator: Daniel Hernan Sacoto, Camila Alejandra Villavicencio, Alberto Franco-Akel, Regina Belokovskaya
pmc-10555955.description: Disclosure: D.H. Sacoto: None. C.A. Villavicencio: None. A. Franco-Akel, MD: None. R. Belokovskaya: None.Thyroid storm is a rare and life-threatening syndrome. Despite treatment and supportive measures, it has an estimated mortality around 8–25%. Identifying atypical clinical presentation such as psychosis is crucial since prompt diagnosis and treatment is paramount for survival.

pmc-11320174.title: Optimized gadolinium-DO3A loading in RAFT-polymerized copolymers for superior MR imaging of aging blood–brain barrier†
pmc-11320174.creator: Hunter A. Miller, Aaron Priester, Evan T. Curtis, Krista Hilmas, Ashleigh Abbott, Forrest M. Kievit, Anthony J. Convertine
pmc-11320174.description: The development of gadolinium-based contrast agents (GBCAs) has been pivotal in advancing magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), offering enhanced soft tissue contrast without ionizing radiation exposure. Despite their widespread clinical use, the need for improved GBCAs has led to innovations in ligand chemistry and polymer science.

pmc-11603866.title: I can’t feel your face: callous-unemotional traits, social anxiety, and approach-avoidance behaviour in conduct disorder
pmc-11603866.creator: Laura M. Derks, Eni S. Becker, Mike Rinck, Martin Holtmann, Tanja Legenbauer, Wolf-Gero Lange
pmc-11603866.description: Background and objectivesConduct disorders are associated with deficits in interpersonal behaviour. Both, callous-unemotional traits and social anxiety are often elevated in patients with conduct disorder and are associated with aggressive approach or disproportional avoidance. Previous studies have focused mainly on questionnaire reports of interpersonal behaviour, whereas direct explicit and implicit interpersonal behaviour in social contexts has not been considered sufficiently.

pmc-12470285.title: The Prediction of Early Neurological Outcomes in Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest Patients: A Multicenter Prospective Cohort Study by the KORHN Registry
pmc-12470285.creator: Wook Jin Choi, Jae Hoon Lee, Jan-Thorsten Gräsner
pmc-12470285.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Early neuroprognostication after cardiac arrest is essential for guiding treatment strategies and providing accurate prognostic information to families. While several early risk scores have been proposed, few have incorporated a wide range of variables in large cohorts.

pmc-12506328.title: A ternary-code DNA methylome atlas of mouse tissues
pmc-12506328.creator: Sol Moe Lee, David C. Goldberg, Cameron Cloud, Jared B. Parker, Christopher Krapp, Christian E. Loo, Elliot Kim, Ivan Zhao, Chengcheng Jin, Rishi Porecha, Marisa S. Bartolomei, Rahul M. Kohli, Wanding Zhou
pmc-12506328.description: BackgroundDNA cytosine modifications, including 5-methylcytosine (5mC) and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC), are key epigenetic regulators with distinct functions. Dissecting the ternary code (C, 5mC, 5hmC) across tissues and cell types remains a critical priority due to the limitations of traditional profiling methods based on bisulfite conversion.

pmc-12636151.title: Gaps in diagnosis and unmet healthcare needs in male sexual dysfunction and chronic health conditions: insights from a German population-based study
pmc-12636151.creator: Elena Mühle, Selina M Kronthaler, Carlotta Oesterling, Tatjana Tissen-Diabaté, Klaus M Beier, Jörg Neymeyer, Thorsten Schlomm, Laura Hatzler
pmc-12636151.description: BackgroundChronic health conditions (CHC), both somatic and mental, increase the risk of sexual dysfunctions (SD) in men, which are associated with reduced quality of life. Despite existing guidelines, help-seeking remains low due to barriers such as shame and limited access, with many turning to anonymous sources.

pmc-12714390.title: The effectiveness of a hybrid mindfulness-based intervention in reducing stress among informal caregivers of people with dementia: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12714390.creator: Patrick Pui Kin Kor, Alex Pak Lik Tsang, Daniel Lok Lam Lai, Justina Yat Wa Liu, Joseph E Gaugler
pmc-12714390.description: Background and ObjectivesInformal caregivers of people with dementia experience significant caregiving stress. Mindfulness-based interventions are effective approaches for alleviating caregiving stress. However, traditional mindfulness training is intensive and challenging to attend due to the substantial caregiving responsibilities of this population, leading to issues with program attrition and adherence.

pmc-12729703.title: Whole-Genome Methylation Analysis of Female, Male, and Neomale Northern Pike (Esox lucius)
pmc-12729703.creator: Zhelan Wang, Qian Xiao, Jiaqing Xu, Xinan Fu, Sitong Li, Jia Wang, Junjie Zhang
pmc-12729703.description: Simple SummarySex determination and differentiation are key biological processes of northern pike (Esox lucius). Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (WGBS), which identifies relevant key genes by analyzing DNA methylation differences, has been widely used in studies on animal epigenetic regulation. However, genome-wide studies on northern pike in this field are currently scarce.

pmc-12735258.title: Molecular, Physiological, and Histopathological Insights into the Protective Role of Equisetum arvense and Olea europaea Extracts Against Metronidazole-Induced Pancreatic Toxicity
pmc-12735258.creator: Manal R. Bakeer, Maha M. Rashad, Asmaa A. Azouz, Rehab A. Azouz, Abdulmajeed Fahad Alrefaei, Sultan F. Kadasah, Mohamed Shaalan, Alaa M. Ali, Marwa Y. Issa, Salma I. El-Samanoudy
pmc-12735258.description: Background: Acute pancreatitis is a significant global disease. This study investigated the phytochemical composition and potential protective effects of Equisetum arvense L. (horsetail) ethanol extract and Olea europaea L. (olive leaves) aqueous extract against metronidazole (MTZ)-induced pancreatic damage in rats.

pmc-13117770.title: Mortality of Candidozyma auris Candidemia Compared with Non-C. auris Candidemia
pmc-13117770.creator: Sungsoo Park, Heesuk Kim, Kilchae Hwang, Duckjin Hong, Hyeyoung Oh
pmc-13117770.description: Candidozyma auris (formerly Candida auris) is frequently multidrug-resistant, resulting in limited treatment options and high mortality. Comparable mortality between C. auris candidemia and non-C. auris candidemia in recent studies requires confirmation in the Middle East after adjustment for confounders. This study aimed to compare mortality rates between patients with candidemia by C. auris and non-C. auris Candida species.

pmc-13152993.title: When Do Antidepressants “Kick In”: Addressing the 2–4-Week Myth
pmc-13152993.creator: Stefani Mihilli, Anthony Levitt, Marco Solmi, Mark Sinyor, Ayal Schaffer
pmc-13152993.description: lished recommendations surrounding what to tell patients and the precise interpretation of evidence regarding the time to onset of antidepressants. pmc-13579158.title: Genomic language model for predicting enhancers and their allele-specific activity in the human genome
pmc-13579158.creator: Rekha Sathian, Pratik Dutta, Ferhat Ay, Ramana V Davuluri, Can Alkan
pmc-13579158.description: MotivationPredicting and deciphering the regulatory logic of enhancers remains a significant challenge due to their complex sequence features and the absence of consistent genetic or epigenetic signatures that distinguish them from other genomic regions. Existing machine learning methods capture nucleotide composition but often fail to model sequence context effectively.

pmc-13668302.title: Clinical, safety, and patient-reported outcomes associated with second-line and later therapies in primary biliary cholangitis: A systematic review
pmc-13668302.creator: Marco Carbone, David Jones, Oyinkan Solanke, Rikke Brandt, Taryn Krause, Darren Asquith, Alex Pashley, Sonia Shaw, Emma Worthington, Jörn M Schattenberg
pmc-13668302.description: Background:Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) is a rare, chronic, cholestatic disease that can result in cirrhosis, liver failure, and death. While biochemical markers such as alkaline phosphatase (ALP) and total bilirubin (TB) measure disease activity and progression, definitions of biochemical response vary.
